race.description: Auto Masters Baringa & Beerwah Mdn Hcp
race.comment: TSZINSI (10) has returned in good order with consecutive Gold Coast seconds and is now third-up and keeps the 3kg claim. She was well-supported last start off a strong return and kept chasing but just found a stronger one. Can put it all together now. PUNISHMENT DAY (9) resumes after a debut sixth at Doomben that reads better than the bare result, given he jumped awkwardly and raced wide. Has been fitted with two trials and gets the key booking of Thompson. Have to take seriously. WILD LASS (16) exceeded expectations fresh when filling the frame at a big quote. Draw will test her but she deserves more respect this time. NO WALLET REG (14) was no match for an impressive winner here last time but still stuck on soundly into third. Draws to give a sight
